name: Brew Cards
tagline: BrewReel's cards style: a warm two-colour gradient, 900-weight outlined captions in the upper third, one fact per beat.

motion.direction: BrewReel `cards`, warm-emotion theme. A two-colour gradient ground (`mar` top → `stage` bottom), white info cards, 120 BPM; captions 900-weight white with a thick outline in the UPPER third (band y 260–540, above the content area), the highlighted word in hot yellow `gold`, word-by-word lit with the voice, ≤ 2 lines. Hook 2–3 s on frame 0 → 3–7 middle shots (compare / steps / meter / `counter`) → end card 4 s; one new fact per beat; ≥ 0.5 s stillness at the end. Spring entrances, no slams; no invented numbers.
